set.body: Pin exact source revisions and executable environments for RSA Toolbox MATLAB, Python rsatoolbox, and PyMVPA. Define canonical fixtures, pair order, tolerances, parity dispositions, scenario IDs, machine-readable result schema, and append-only findings/ergonomics ledger. Acceptance: every capability in intended overlap has exactly one disposition and every recorded output is bound to source, environment, fixture, and comparison policy.
